review_notes: Reviewed all 58 lines, the underlying matrix and divergence definitions, the weak-form and moment proofs, and representative downstream uses. The proposed generalization is source-supported but has not been compiled.

findings.problem: This reusable regularity lemma requires infinite smoothness even though forming the flux only loses one derivative of u. Downstream code also uses it merely to obtain C¹ regularity.
findings.benefit: Makes the flux API usable with finite-regularity coefficients and potentials—for example, C¹ H and C² u suffice for C¹ flux—without changing the existing smooth-source theorem or introducing new mathematics.
